description_en: Queries hotword libraries that meet specific search conditions
description_zh: 获取指定条件下的所有热词库信息
kebab_example: aliyun ice list-hotword-libraries --next-token 000073f33c91-d59383e8280b0000 --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by CreationTime:Desc --name Hotword_library_name --usage-scenario ASR --start-time 2020-12-26T04:11:10Z --end-time 2020-12-26T04:11:10Z --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHotwordLibraries

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The sorting order. By default, the query results are sorted by creation time in descending order
parameters.help_zh: 排序参数，默认根据创建时间倒序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The name of the hotword library
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The usage scenario of the hotword library. Valid values:

ASR: Automatic Speech Recognition

StructuredMediaAssets: structured media analysis

VideoTranslation: Video translation. This field cannot be modified after the hotword library is created
parameters.help_zh:
词库的使用场景：

ASR智能文本识别：ASR
结构化媒资：StructuredMediaAssets
视频翻译：VideoTranslation 词库一旦新增后，该字段不可修改
parameters.name: usage_scenario

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return.

Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh:
本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。

最大值：100，默认值：10
parameters.name: max_results
